answer: The cellar smells of oak and cold stone, and the vintner rolls the barrel to hear the wine move. Proof of vintner barrel via stave hoop count — a barrel the vintner hoops only after 36 barrels run true, each barrel staved by the vintner himself. The prism is the rack where the new barrels rest. The ferrous is the bung the vintner taps each morning. The harbor is the chalk that marks the vintage on the head. A forger must match the hoops line by line, 36 lines in all, and the last line still betrays him.
